constraints.text: Email of a User is unique among all Users.
profile_image of a User, message of a Drink Version, notes of a Review, and icon and photo of an Album can be empty.
Popularity of a Drink is calculated from the number of Reviews of all its Drink Versions and the number of Albums, that include the Drink.
average_rating of a Drink is the average of number_of_stars of the Reviews of all its Drink Versions.
Version numbers of the Drink Versions of a Drink are consecutive numbers starting from 1. add_version() gives the new Drink Version the highest version number of its Drink plus one.
A Drink Version is based on a Drink Version of the same Drink with a lower version_number. Only version 1 is based on no Drink Version.
Each Drink Version belongs to a branch of its Drink. A new Drink Version continues a branch only from the Drink Version of that branch with the highest version_number.
base_spirit of a Drink is empty exactly when the Drink has no alcohol, that is, when total_alcohol_percentage of its latest Drink Version is 0.
add_version() can be called by any User, also for a Drink authored by someone else. The new Drink Version is authored by the calling User, and the Drink Version, on which it is based, is not changed.
alcohol_percentage of an Ingredient is a number from 0 to 100.
total_volume of a Drink Version is the sum of the amounts of its Contains entries, converted to one unit.
total_alcohol_percentage of a Drink Version is the sum of amount times alcohol_percentage of its Ingredients, divided by total_volume.
A Drink Version is a mocktail exactly when its total_alcohol_percentage is 0. Every other Drink Version is alcoholic.
flavour_distribution of a Drink Version is calculated from the amounts and the Ingredients it contains.
estimated_match of a Drink Version is a percentage from 0 to 100, calculated from its Ingredients and the Flavour Preferences it prefers, when it is saved.
sweetness, sourness, spiciness, bitterness, fruitiness, herbalness, smokiness, fizziness and intensity are whole numbers from 0 to 20.
Each Flavour Preferences belongs either to exactly one User or to exactly one Drink Version, never to both.
number_of_stars of a Review is a whole number from 1 to 5.
Each User has exactly one Album of the kinds favourites, to_check_out and your_drinks, and these Albums cannot be deleted.
An Album without an icon uses the default icon.
number_of_drinks of an Album is the number of its Includes entries.
The Album of the kind your_drinks includes exactly the Drinks, which have a Drink Version authored by the owner of the Album.
share() and withdraw() can be called only by the owner of the Album. share() sets public_status to true and withdraw() sets it to false.
A private Album is visible only to its owner. A public Album is visible to all Users and Guests.
Deleting a User deletes its Passkeys, its Flavour Preferences, its Reviews, its liked Ingredients and its Albums.
amount of a Contains entry is greater than 0.
constraints.assumed: An ingredient of a drink must have a positive amount, although the matrix does not say it.
